patterns.note: A full-width hero image with overlaid text is used, followed by distinct, full-width content sections that alternate between product grids and lifestyle imagery.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established using a bold, decorative serif for key display text and a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy and navigation.
The palette combines warm, earthy neutrals for backgrounds and text with a deep, rich red for primary calls-to-action and sale indicators, creating a sophisticated yet inviting feel.

The initial top announcement bar collapses on scroll, while the main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top. The hero image background exhibits a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls down the page.
Product browsing is organized into distinct 'Shop by' sections (Size, Color, Room) that utilize horizontal carousels for efficient content display.

technique_notes: The top announcement bar is designed to animate out of view or collapse its height when the user scrolls past the initial viewport, while the main navigation bar transitions to a fixed position at the top of the screen, maintaining accessibility.
The hero section employs a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect as the user navigates down the page.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing visual engagement and guiding the user's attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (Apris) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif body text (Manrope) with good line spacing.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on product cards and buttons, creating a soft but refined feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout, with generous vertical padding between main sections and a slightly denser grid for product displays.

standout: The site effectively combines aspirational lifestyle photography with a highly functional e-commerce layout. The emphasis on 'washable rugs' is clearly communicated through dedicated sections and imagery, making a strong case for its unique selling proposition. The use of carousels for various 'Shop by' categories (size, color, room) provides an intuitive and engaging browsing experience.
